title: DNI, DHS, and FBI officials tell Congress they have found no evidence that recent US tech outages were connected to each other or caused by cyberattacks (Nicole Sganga/CBS News)
summary: Nicole Sganga / CBS News: DNI, DHS, and FBI officials tell Congress they have found no evidence that recent US tech outages were connected to each other or caused by cyberattacks — Nicole Sganga is CBS News' homeland security and justice correspondent. She is based in Washington, D.C., and reports for all shows and platforms.
